## Pull request checklist

- [ ] Scope is focused and the description explains the change.
- [ ] Relevant tests or documentation checks were run (`bun run typecheck`, `bun run build`, `bun test`, plus any integration suites you enabled).
- [ ] No secrets, generated noise, or unrelated changes are included.
- [ ] Dependency changes respect the update schedules in [`.github/dependabot.yml`](https://github.com/T-Py-T/SwarmSpindle/blob/main/.github/dependabot.yml).

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/T-Py-T/SwarmSpindle/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for setup and validation details.
